mapper.select:
SELECT a.address_id, a.user_id, u.user_name, a.receiver_name, a.phone, a.region, a.detail_address, a.tag, a.is_default, a.is_pickup, a.create_by, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, a.update_by, DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time FROM shop_address a LEFT JOIN shop_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id
AND a.user_id = #{userId}
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND a.receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{receiverName}, '%')
ORDER BY a.is_default DESC, a.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_address (user_id, receiver_name, phone, region, detail_address, tag, is_default, is_pickup, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{phone}, #{region}, #{detailAddress}, #{tag}, #{isDefault}, #{isPickup}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_address SET is_default = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1
UPDATE shop_address SET is_pickup = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_pickup = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shop_address WHERE address_id = #{addressId} AND user_id = #{userId}
